content_units.proposition: Student: If everyone has permission to enter, does my entry not always force others to make way? Teacher: You are confusing not being prohibited yourself with other people's duty to cooperate. The rules impose no duty on others to give up their places. Whether objects blocking the entrance create some other duty is beyond the materials we have; do not extend this into a conclusion.
